name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.3.1: /superskillret:setup brings the plugin to a fully-ready state synchronously (install.sh + daemon spawn + verification) with live progress, so you don't waste 1-2 prompts on the lazy-fork wait notices. v0.3.0 PLUGIN_ROOT uses CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT first with clear fallback. v0.2.9 Python 3.9 compat. v0.2.8 daemon health line + list/remove cli. v0.2.0–0.2.7 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
